gloss: lodging fee; accommodation cost; room charge

definitions.gloss: lodging fee; accommodation cost; room charge
definitions.explanation: The cost of staying at a hotel, inn, or other accommodation. A colloquial and practical term used when discussing travel expenses.

examples.japanese: {宿代|やどだい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いくらです⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: How much is the lodging fee?

examples.japanese: {宿代|やどだい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{節約|せつやく}する→節約する：25226_setsuyakusuru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ゲストハウス→ゲストハウス：29675_gesutohausu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{泊|と}まった→泊まる：10445_tomaru⟧。
examples.english: I stayed at a guesthouse to save on accommodation costs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧のうち、{宿代|やどだい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{出費|しゅっぴ}→出費：09205_shuppi⟧だった。
examples.english: Of the travel budget, lodging was the biggest expense.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{宿|やど}→宿：03641_yado⟧ (inn; lodging) and ⟦{代|だい}→〜代：28331_dai⟧ (fee; charge). This is the everyday, conversational way to refer to accommodation costs. The word ⟦{宿|やど}→宿：03641_yado⟧ by itself can mean any kind of lodging, from a traditional ⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧ to a modern hotel.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {宿代|やどだい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧: to pay the lodging fee
- {宿代|やどだい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{節約|せつやく}する→節約する：25226_setsuyakusuru⟧: to save on lodging costs
- {宿代|やどだい}⟦{込|こ}み→込み：28615_komi⟧: lodging included
- ⟦{一泊|いっぱく}→一泊：08892_ippaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{宿代|やどだい}: cost per night

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{宿泊料|しゅくはくりょう}→宿泊料：07142_shukuhakuryou⟧: accommodation fee — more formal; used in hotel pricing and official documents
- ⟦{宿泊費|しゅくはくひ}→宿泊費：25963_shukuhakuhi⟧: accommodation expenses — used in expense reports and budgeting
- {部屋代|へやだい}: room charge — focuses on the room itself rather than the lodging experience
